lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build provides open hexagonal shelving on two levels with storage surfaces for books, plus lower drawers.

**Note on load rating:** The configurator only checks geometric fit and mesh clearance, not structural strength or load capacity. I cannot verify or claim a 50 kg rating within this tool; that requires engineering analysis outside Hex Cluster.

Built with 4× Full bases (0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 1,0,1 / 0,1,1) forming a 2-level shelf frame, and 2× Half-S bases (1,1,0 and 0,2,0) providing drawer housings. MeshClash is clear.
